title: When love and family are tangled
intro: A careful place to explore in-laws, family pressure, loyalty, and the peace you want at home.

sections.heading: Separate roles
sections.body: You can care about family without accepting every demand.

sections.heading: Protect the relationship
sections.body: Talk with your partner about the boundary together.

sections.heading: Choose repeatable peace
sections.body: Look for a practice you can maintain, not a dramatic one-time fix.
